topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Well now, this be the first time I ever gazed upon a day quite like this. The morning’s dew had barely lifted when I saw young Thomas marching up the path, his old schoolbook under one arm and a parcel wrapped neat in his hands. He placed it on the table before me, a look in his eyes that shone brighter than the golden wheat at harvest. I asked not what it held, for the weight of it was light, yet the import seemed heavy as a boulder. As I unwrapped it, there it lay—a finely crafted quill, the feather so white and pure, fit for a scribe of kings. I looked at him, then back at the quill, and knew in my heart that this gift, given freely, was more than just an object. It spoke of remembrance, of the learning we shared, and the future he’s shaping.
